hypotheses.statement: Increasing u increases steady-state y with positive gain (heater warms sensor).
Response has first-order lag of tens of seconds; settling takes several times the initial lag, so a 180s hold may not fully settle.
There is no large dead zone: u=0.5 clearly produces a rise above ambient.
At u=0, y decays on its own toward ambient near 0.05 due to heat loss to room.
Steady-state gain is approximately linear across u in [0,1].
Steady-state u needed to hold target y=0.5 is in mid-range approx 0.2-0.8.
Sensor noise is small (<0.01) relative to control band width 0.05.
